message.content: {"4": {"original": "The lawmaking process was quite a bumpy one, evolving from a surprise amendment", "rephrased": "The legislative process for the new French copyright law has been turbulent, transforming an initial proposal to legalize peer-to-peer file sharing into a constitutional crisis that ultimately forced lawmakers to abandon that specific provision.", "summary": "France's copyright law drafting evolved from a controversial peer-to-peer legalization into a constitutional crisis."}, "5": {"original": "Some lawmakers decried intense lobbying by the entertainment industry.", "rephrased": "French legislators from both the governing majority and the opposition have criticized the intense lobbying efforts by the entertainment industry, which they argue has unduly influenced the drafting of the new copyright legislation.", "summary": "French lawmakers from all political factions criticize the entertainment industry's intense lobbying of the copyright law."}, "6": {"original": "Some amendments were nicknamed the 'Vivendi Universal amendment'.", "rephrased": "Certain provisions within the French copyright bill have been informally labeled the 'Vivendi Universal amendment' by critics, who suggest that specific clauses were directly inspired by the commercial interests of the major entertainment conglomerate Vivendi Universal.", "summary": "Critics have nicknamed specific clauses in the French copyright bill the 'Vivendi Universal amendment'."}, "7": {"original": "UMP lawmakers denounced pressures and even blackmail from powerful lobbies.", "rephrased": "Members of the French majority party, the UMP, have strongly denounced the use of political pressure and even blackmail by powerful lobbies to secure support for the controversial copyright law amendments.", "summary": "French UMP lawmakers denounce political pressure and blackmail by powerful lobbies regarding the copyright law."}}
